metadata.title: On the $L$-embeddability of Lipschitz-free spaces in their biduals
metadata.abstract: A Banach space $X$ is $L$-embedded in its bidual if there is a projection $P\colon X^{**}\to X$ such that $\|x\|=\|Px\|+\|x-Px\|$ for all $x\in X^{**}$. We show that, as long as $X$ has dimension at least $2$, its Lipschitz-free space, denoted by $\mathcal{F}(X)$, is not $L$-embedded in its bidual. Our methods have applications to the problem of when the $L$-embeddability of $\mathcal{F}(M)$ passes to $\mathcal{F}(A)$ for a metric space $M$ and $A\subseteq M$. This is the case when $A$ is compact or when $A$ is geodesically closed.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: Lipschitz-free 空间的 L-embedding 障碍
analysis.workSummary: 证明维数至少二的 Banach 空间 X，其 Lipschitz-free 空间 F(X) 不能 L-embedded 于 bidual；并研究 metric subset 的 L-embedding 继承，compact 或 geodesically closed 子集可继承。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出广泛的不可嵌入结果及子空间继承条件。
analysis.limitations: 基空间维数要求至少二；一般 metric subset 的继承仍需条件。
